capabilities: configure the Kenku FM remote play URL in settings
play sounds from any soundboard via the command palette
stop playback of active sound tracks
force-reload soundboard data when out of sync
extras: Author states the plugin was made without generative AI; a manual reload command exists for when state drifts after controlling sounds in the Kenku FM app directly.
problem: Obsidian has no way to trigger sound playback from an external soundboard app, so users must switch to Kenku FM while working in their vault.
summary: Remote control for Kenku FM soundboards that lets you play and stop sounds from Obsidian commands.
